business_process: Outgoing and incoming wire transfers (bank customers)
description: Receive wire requests from branches, relationship managers, and business online banking; verify by callback; key and approve (maker-checker); send and receive through the Federal Reserve payment services; post to the core
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 260 outgoing customer wires (about $110 million) a day; closings and payrolls depend on same-day settlement; a wire sent without its record risks a duplicate or lost payment, so data loss must be near zero; 8 hours is one business day
manual_workaround: Secondary wire room at the Georgia regional office with 2 payments workstations; offline request log; wires above $250,000 need COO approval while on the alternate procedure
dependent_systems: SYS-03; SYS-05; SYS-06 (production account); SYS-07 (payments workstations); SYS-01
dependent_third_parties: Federal Reserve payment services; core processor; cloud provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Primary wire room (14 staff on the access list); secondary wire room (4 cross-trained staff)
quantified_operational_impact: About 260 customer wires ($110 million) delayed per day; each hour down pushes about 35 wires toward the settlement cutoff
quantified_regulatory_impact: Missed settlement triggers interest compensation claims under funds transfer agreements; a notification incident under 12 CFR 53.3 if services to a material portion of customers are disrupted
customer_harm_impact: Severe: customers miss real estate closings and payroll funding

business_process: Correspondent wire and ACH processing for 18 respondent institutions
description: Receive respondents payment orders through the correspondent portal; screen, send, and settle through the bank Federal Reserve accounts; daily settlement statements to respondents
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 120 wires (about $55 million) and 40 ACH files a day for respondents; respondents customers miss settlement; the bank may owe respondents a 53.4 notice if an incident disrupts covered services for 4 hours or more
manual_workaround: Respondents send urgent wires by authenticated fax or secure email with callback to their designated officers; bank keys them in the payments hub from the secondary wire room
dependent_systems: SYS-03 (correspondent portal); SYS-05 (customer identity service); SYS-06; SYS-01
dependent_third_parties: Federal Reserve payment services; cloud provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Correspondent operations (9 staff); primary and secondary wire rooms
quantified_operational_impact: 18 institutions and their customers affected; about $55 million of respondent payments delayed per day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Outbound notice to respondent banks under 12 CFR 53.4 (bank as service provider, per General Counsel); contract claims; loss of the business line is a franchise-value question under 53.2(b)(7)(ii)

business_process: Branch teller and deposit account services
description: Deposits, withdrawals, check cashing, and cash services at 28 branches and 58 ATMs and interactive teller machines
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers cannot reach their money at any branch; about $30,000 of deposit service charges a business day; offline teller mode covers part of a day
manual_workaround: Core processor offline teller mode with per-transaction limits; post from offline files when the core returns
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-07 (170 teller workstations; branch networks); SYS-05
dependent_third_parties: Core processor; SD-WAN and circuit carriers
quantified_operational_impact: About 9,000 branch transactions a day; offline mode limits withdrawals to $1,000
quantified_regulatory_impact: Customer complaints; possible notification incident if all branches are down (12 CFR 53.2(b)(7)(i))
customer_harm_impact: Severe: customers cannot access cash for payroll, rent, or benefits

business_process: Online and mobile banking (consumer and business)
description: Balances, transfers, bill payment, mobile deposit, and business wire, ACH, and positive pay for about 77,000 enrolled users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers expect 24x7 access; business users initiate wires, ACH, and positive pay decisions here; outages drive contact center volume and social media complaints
manual_workaround: Branches and the contact center; business wire requests to relationship managers with callback; ACH files by secure upload to payments operations; positive pay decisions by phone
quantified_operational_impact: About 77,000 users; contact center calls rise about 4 times during outages
quantified_regulatory_impact: Notification incident question if a material portion of customers cannot bank
customer_harm_impact: Moderate: delayed transfers and bill payments

description: Business customer ACH files (1,050 originators), incoming payroll and benefit credits, returns and exceptions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Missing a settlement window delays customer payrolls; incoming government benefit credits must post on the settlement date
manual_workaround: Process files at the next settlement window from the secondary wire room; post incoming files manually from the Federal Reserve report
dependent_third_parties: Federal Reserve payment services; core processor
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,050 originators; about 60,000 ACH items a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Late returns and settlement exceptions under network rules
customer_harm_impact: Severe: payroll and benefit credits delayed

business_process: Treasury management services (positive pay, remote deposit capture, sweeps)
description: Business positive pay decisions, remote deposit capture, account sweeps and zero-balance accounts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Positive pay decisions have same-day deadlines; sweeps affect customer liquidity
manual_workaround: Positive pay decisions by phone to treasury operations; branch deposit of checks; manual sweep entries
quantified_operational_impact: About 700 positive pay customers; about 2,000 remote deposit items a day
customer_harm_impact: Moderate: check fraud exposure if positive pay decisions lapse

description: Card authorization, ATM and interactive teller machine cash access, card fraud monitoring
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The card processor runs stand-in authorization if the core is down; customers can use branches or other networks
manual_workaround: Card processor stand-in limits; branch cash withdrawals
quantified_operational_impact: About 38,000 card transactions a day; stand-in approves within preset limits
customer_harm_impact: Moderate: declined cards and ATM outages

business_process: Customer contact center, fraud line, and phones
description: Customer service and fraud reporting lines, card blocks, contact-information changes by phone, and wire callbacks from branches
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Callbacks for wire requests and fraud reporting depend on working phones; customers must be able to report fraud and lost cards
manual_workaround: Forward main lines to cell phones; callbacks from branch cell phones to the number on file; recorded outage message
customer_harm_impact: Moderate: fraud not reported quickly; card blocks delayed

description: Loan payment posting, escrow, payoffs, and line of credit draws
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payoff quotes and draws have closing deadlines; late posting creates customer disputes
manual_workaround: Accept payments and post when the core returns; manual payoff calculation by loan operations
quantified_operational_impact: About 400 payments and 25 payoffs a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Late fees and escrow errors must be corrected
customer_harm_impact: Moderate: delayed closings and disputed late fees

business_process: Commercial, consumer, and small business loan origination (including the AI credit model)
description: Applications, credit decisions (AI-001 for small business applications up to $500,000), adverse action notices, closings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Regulation B notice timing is measured in days, not hours; about 650 small business applications a year
manual_workaround: Paper applications and manual underwriting (the model is advisory; officers decide)
dependent_third_parties: LOS vendor; credit bureaus; AI model vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Loan officers, underwriters, and credit administration
quantified_operational_impact: About 12 applications and 6 closings a business day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Adverse action notices due within Regulation B time frames (12 CFR 1002.9)

description: Applications, disclosures, underwriting, and scheduled closings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Closings are scheduled days ahead; disclosure timing is counted in days
manual_workaround: Reschedule closings; manual disclosures from templates
dependent_third_parties: LOS vendor; title and settlement agents
quantified_regulatory_impact: Disclosure timing requirements must be met after restoration
customer_harm_impact: Moderate: missed closing dates for home buyers

business_process: BSA/AML monitoring, investigations, and SAR filing
description: Transaction monitoring alerts (AI-002), customer due diligence, currency transaction reports, SARs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SAR and currency transaction report deadlines are counted in days; alerts must not be lost
manual_workaround: Work the alert backlog when restored; manual review of large cash and wire activity from core reports
quantified_regulatory_impact: SAR within 30 calendar days of initial detection (12 CFR 21.11(d)); a backlog risks late filings

business_process: General ledger, liquidity, and regulatory reporting
description: Daily reserve and liquidity position, general ledger, Call Report
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The daily funding position must be known before large wires are released; Call Report deadlines are quarterly
manual_workaround: Estimate the position from the Federal Reserve account statement and the payments hub log; hold large outgoing wires until confirmed
dependent_third_parties: Core processor; Federal Reserve payment services
quantified_operational_impact: Liquidity position for $2.5 billion balance sheet; about $220 million of daily outgoing payments
quantified_regulatory_impact: Overdraft at the Federal Reserve account; late regulatory reports

description: Branch and remote check capture, clearing, returns, and exception items on the headquarters item processing servers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Returns and exception deadlines are next business day; float and fraud exposure grow each day
manual_workaround: Hold items; transport paper to the item processing provider; manual returns
dependent_systems: SYS-07 (item processing servers; 14 legacy servers); SYS-01
quantified_regulatory_impact: Late returns shift loss to the bank under check clearing rules

business_process: Account opening and maintenance (including contact-information changes)
description: New accounts with customer identification, and changes to names, addresses, phone numbers, email, and authorized signers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer identification records must not be lost; unverified contact changes are a fraud path (gap 2)
manual_workaround: Defer account openings; accept maintenance only in person with identification
quantified_operational_impact: About 150 new accounts and 600 maintenance requests a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Customer identification records; Red Flags program (12 CFR 41.90)
customer_harm_impact: Moderate: unverified changes enable account takeover

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, and termination notices to IT
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; termination notices to IT must continue so access is removed on time
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider; termination notices by phone to the service desk

business_process: Data warehouse, management reporting, and analytics
description: Nightly core extract, management reports, fair lending and model monitoring data
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reports can be rebuilt from core reports; model monitoring runs monthly
